verdict.line: You lose this lane walking into auto-attack range without three Q stacks built, and you win it by timing R (Devour) onto his all-in or his R (Fear Beyond Death) channel.

brief.thesis: Urgot out-pokes you for free with autos, Q (Corrosive Charge, range 800), and W (Purge, range 490) thanks to Echoing Flames, so your only safe damage source before 6 is Q (Tongue Lash, range 900), which outranges all three and heals you on hit. The 48% win rate over 123 games reflects a lane that is decided by stack-and-stun timing, not raw stats — whoever lands the Acquired Taste stun or the Devour combo first wins the exchange, and that depends on tracking his E (Disdain) cooldown, his only escape.

theirWindow.what: He can tank your Q poke, trade autos, and if you commit W (Abyssal Dive) or go for the stun he can shield through and fling you out of his way to disengage clean.

yourWindow.what: This is when your all-in sticks. Land the fourth Q hit to consume his three Acquired Taste stacks for the stun, then immediately R (Devour) him — he has no tool left to escape or punish it.

start.why: 74.5% pick at 47.5% win rate over 120 games — the passive damage reduction on autos directly answers Urgot's poke-heavy early kit.

boots.why: 72.1% pick at 42.3% win rate over 111 games — Urgot's Echoing Flames triggers off basic attacks, so flat auto-damage reduction matters more than move speed here.

core.why: Stacks raw health, which scales An Acquired Taste's bonus damage on every hit and feeds Thick Skin's stored-damage shield.
Continues the health-stacking into the mid-game trade window, the strongest measured path (91.7% win rate over 12 games with Riftmaker).
Converts the stacked health into sustained magic damage for extended Q/Devour trades, the top-performing third item in the sample.

situational.when: urgot is leaning on autos and Purge to win trades rather than Q poke
you need more healing amplification out of Thick Skin and Devour in longer fights
you need to dodge Corrosive Charge zones and close the gap before Disdain comes back up

runes.keystoneWhy: Rewards the sustained auto/Q poke trade this lane is built on, converting health and damage into permanent max-health growth that scales your passive back.

summoners.why: Highest pick rate at 61.4%; Ignite secures the kill the instant your Q-stack stun plus R Devour combo lands, since Urgot's Disdain makes him slippery once he's low.

playing.title: Poke, don't walk up
playing.detail: Lead every interaction with Q (Tongue Lash, range 900) — it outranges his W (Purge, range 490) and his Q (Corrosive Charge, range 800), slows the first thing it hits, and heals you if it's him.

playing.title: Track Disdain before committing
playing.detail: Only go for your all-in — W (Abyssal Dive) engage into the Q-stack stun into R (Devour) — when his E (Disdain) is on cooldown. If it's up he can shield through it and fling you away.

playing.title: Stack to the stun
playing.detail: Any damage you land builds Acquired Taste; the hit that brings him to three stacks stuns him and consumes them. Chain your next action straight into R (Devour) for a near-guaranteed burst.

playing.title: Devour his ultimate
playing.detail: At level 6+, the moment he channels R (Fear Beyond Death) on you or an ally, Devour him immediately — it removes him from the fight for the duration and the impale never lands.

playing.title: Bank E before his damage lands
playing.detail: Thick Skin (E, 3s cooldown) stores a percent of damage taken while out of combat passively. Pop it into a shield right before his Purge channel or Q explosion connects to turn stored damage into free EHP.

playing.title: Respect maxed Purge
playing.detail: His W (Purge) drops to a 0s cooldown at rank 5, letting him unload repeatedly in long fights. Don't sit in auto range during extended trades once he's maxed it — disengage and let Q sustain you instead.

playing.title: Prioritize health items over damage
playing.detail: Heartsteel and Dusk and Dawn's raw health directly scales your passive's bonus damage on every attack — finish them before detouring into pure damage items.

brief.patchCaveat: The build order, rune page, summoner spells, and all win-rate/pick-rate figures above come from measured Tahm Kench vs Urgot games on the current patch via OP.GG. The tactical reasoning — Q-range poke priority, tracking Disdain's cooldown, and Devour-the-ultimate timing — is our own read of the mechanics, not part of the sourced data.

stats.opponentTip: Do not close in often as he deals a lot of consistent damage. Try to use [Q] to poke from afar before closing in for the kill. After reaching level 6, swallow him with [W] when he uses (R) to prevent him from dealing damage or kill him before he activates (R).
